**Alpha test build v1.3.0-alpha.5 — client changes** for the Mahuva Vala Rajput Samaj community directory. For invited testers only.

- **MVPMI-v1.3.0-alpha.5-build….apk** (same file as **mvpmi.apk**) — Android 10 or newer; connects to https://samaj.kavigsv.com. Test-signed: **uninstall the previous app first**.

New:
- Community name: **Mahuva Vala Rajput Samaj · મહુવા વાળા રાજપૂત સમાજ**; app name on the phone: **વાળા સમાજ**.
- Names and places in both scripts: whatever language someone typed in, the app shows Gujarati in Gujarati and English in English (existing members are converted automatically; what they typed is kept).
- Sign out moved to My Profile → Options (after Request removal).
- Search tab: the label sits right under the round button.
- Theme button in Gujarati reads **કલર**.

Tested: 142 server tests and 179 browser checks.
